purpose: Define the one supported Financial Writing execution path used by the user: ChatGPT invokes the Financial owner, current GitHub main supplies code/rules and durable article state, and stage capabilities are providers inside that path rather than alternate execution modes.

authority.guard_filename_note: The github_chat_guard.py filename is retained temporarily for code compatibility only. It is the single Financial owner mutation guard, not a selectable GITHUB_CHAT adapter and not a second business workflow.

execution.rule: Every publishable Financial Writing request enters this owner path. Exact-stage capabilities are handshaken only as needed; availability may block an affected stage but never selects a second business-state authority or permits free-form article completion.
execution.provider_rule: Python, plugin, MCP, model, web and document tooling are capability providers inside one owner trajectory. No provider may create a parallel article state store or alternate terminal semantics.

task_contract.single_mode_override_rule: A direct distribution-mode override requires USER_EXPLICIT_OVERRIDE plus distribution_mode_override_evidence that is an exact substring of the original user prompt and is persisted in the INIT receipt.

workflow.mutation_rule: Stage advancement, revision, blocked recovery, feedback mutation and terminalization must be produced by the current deterministic owner guard/lifecycle implementation against freshly read main state and then reread after the write.
workflow.semantic_assurance: CHAT_SELF_REVIEW unless stronger provider-attested evidence is actually present for that exact review action

checkpoint_contract.migration_rule: Existing main article STATE.json using the GITHUB_CHAT token remains readable. The token must never be used to choose an execution route. A future schema migration may rename it only with explicit backward-compatible migration and regression proof.
checkpoint_contract.mutation_conflict_rule: Every material mutation binds the freshly fetched STATE.json blob SHA and writes with the same SHA. Universal lease/epoch fencing remains a separate required outer invariant and is not proven by blob CAS alone.
checkpoint_contract.post_write_verification: Reread STATE.json and every newly referenced artifact from main before claiming COMMITTED.

legacy_quarantine.legacy_owner_runtime_code: May remain temporarily for migration/history, but current Skill/manifest/capability/task handoff must not route new or resumed business work through it.
legacy_quarantine.fallback_rule: No legacy mechanism may become active merely because the current capability set is incomplete. Missing capability blocks the affected stage.

anti_bypass: No publishable final article is produced before a durable article STATE.json exists on main.
No alternate owner-native/plugin/SQLite route may be selected for new Financial business work.
No chat executor may silently change the canonical distribution mode or required-output set.
No Research/Editorial/Title/Draft stage is completed without a durable artifact ref.
No DELIVERY advancement is accepted with a missing applicable article Word output.
No FINAL terminalization is accepted until the complete required_outputs set including AUDIT_DOCX is present.
No per-article business-state branch is created or resumed as current authority.
No historical eval, maintenance branch, chat summary or deprecated runtime store overrides current main authority.
No missing capability authorizes free-form writing.
